source: sars-guide:SARS PAYE-GEN-01-G21 Guide for Employers iro Employees Tax 2027, Revision 1 p. 9-10 (annual equivalent of part-period pay; a part period as its share of days, 3 of 7 = 0.4285) and p. 13; apportionment basis: wave-7 ruling 13 (monthly working days, weekly calendar days), scope ruling 19
notes: Calculator level only. Option B (coordinator ruling on #1901, 2026-11-26; ruling 19 "own rows keep today's behaviour"; Hein 2026-11-02) reverted review R2-M1: in a monthly RUN a leaver's own row ending on their end date before the 27th is not read (not paid; flagged only beside a paid row of its component; payroll-leaver-exemption.int, w7-pra-review3.int). The oracle passes the row straight to the calculator, which never apportions a row ending on the employee's end (the employed window's own edge): this case pins that. Employed since 1 March 2020, last day Wednesday 15 July 2026, age 40; Basic R5 000 recurring to 15 July: gross 5 000; PAYE R0 (under the threshold, G21 p. 13); UIF 50.00 each side; SDL 50.00; net 4 950.00.
